ajay: Hi everyone, ajay here — I'm shadowing on-call this week. Two quick blockers: 1) PD mobile notifications not arriving, 2) can't open the payment-service Grafana dashboard (403). Anyone seen this combo before?

emma: welcome ajay! For PD mobile check the PD app's notification settings + phone verification. Grafana 403 usually means your grafana-org membership isn't set. Ping @ops-iam for both.

ops-iam: I've created ticket OPS-1410 to add ajay to grafana-org and retry PD SMS verification. ETA ~10m. Ajay, can you confirm the phone number country code in a DM?

ajay: DM'd the +1 number. Also one process question: if I'm shadowing and see a customer-facing 5xx spike during a known deploy, should I follow rollback first or page infra?

sre-oncall-bot: Quick rule: if spike correlates with a deploy tag and customer impact is intermittent, follow deploy rollback checklist first. If impact is sustained or affects SLAs, page infra immediately. See runbook link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/oncall/alerts

emma: short practical flow: 1) confirm impact (errors/sla), 2) check deploy window & tag, 3) try rollback actions, 4) page infra if no improvement in 5-10min. Document any mutes.

ajay: thanks. Can I schedule a short mock with someone to walk through alert -> ack -> escalate -> postmortem skeleton? Prefer before the deployment at 20:00 UTC.

emma: I can run a 20-min mock at 19:00 UTC. We'll simulate payments-service 5xx and practice PD escalation + timeline notes. Meet in #eng-oncall, I'll post a calendar invite.

ops-iam: OPS-1410 done: ajay added to grafana-org and PD verification retried. Please check both and confirm.

ajay: Grafana access ✅, PD SMS still pending but web notifications work. Thanks! I'll join the 19:00 mock.

trainr-bot: TRAINING REMINDER: After mock, add an entry to the oncall-training page with date, shadow name, primary, and checklist items completed. Link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/oncall/training

emma: small pre-mock checklist for you ajay: confirm PD ack ability, open dashboards, have jumpbox SSH ready, and skim last 48h incidents. We'll go step-by-step.

ajay: Roger. Thanks all — see you at 19:00. :rocket:
